title: Generation 2 cost, execution, and accounting model — declared as a derivation, not a copy
what_this_file_is: This file is NOT a cost model. It is the declaration of a derivation. Generation 2 does not carry its own copy of the cost numbers: it loads Generation 1's sealed config/stage2_cost_model.json through the existing seal check and then applies exactly the override declared below. A second copy of the numbers would be a second place they could drift, and the copy that drifts is always the one an engine ends up trusting. The operating instruction for Generation 2 says the cost model is out of scope and must not be revised; the only way to honour that mechanically is to never hold a revisable copy of it.

derived_from.loader_note: The Generation 2 loader calls the Generation 1 loader first and lets it raise. If the sealed cost model has drifted by one byte, no Generation 2 run starts.

overrides.source_of_the_value: the k axis of the eighteen-variant grid declared in config/generation_2/g2_rotation_protocol.json
overrides.rationale: Portfolio breadth is the single variable Generation 2 changes (charter section 2). Constitution section 3 bounds it to one position 'in Generation 1', inside a section titled 'Fixed scope for Generation 1'; the resolution is recorded as G2-CONFLICT-2 in the charter.
overrides.enforcement: stockedge100.backtest.costs.CostModel reads this field into max_open_risky_positions, which BacktestEngine._execute_buy uses for its MAX_POSITIONS rejection and Portfolio uses for its own invariant. Raising it is therefore not a suggestion to the engine; it is the number the engine already enforces.

derivation_predicate: The derived mapping must be equal to the sealed mapping at every JSON path except /account/max_open_risky_positions. stockedge100.backtest.g2_costs asserts this by walking both mappings and refusing to construct a CostModel if the difference set is anything other than exactly that one path.

unchanged_and_named_explicitly.note: Named here so that a reader does not have to diff two files to see what Generation 2 did not touch. Every value below is read from the sealed Generation 1 file at run time; the strings here are a description, not a source.

concentration_ceiling.applies_to: any single position, measured as a fraction of account equity, at any rebalance
concentration_ceiling.source: config/stage3_attempt2_strategy_protocol.json risk_architecture.RA1-1.rule (f_base = 0.50), carried forward unchanged as the Generation-1-consistent default, and restated as a requirement by the Generation 2 operating instruction
concentration_ceiling.why_it_is_here_and_not_in_the_cost_model: The sealed Generation 1 cost model has no concentration field, because a one-position portfolio cannot have a concentration problem that the gross-exposure cap does not already cover. Generation 2 cannot add the field to that file — it is frozen — so the ceiling is declared here and enforced in stockedge100.backtest.g2_engine as a named constraint alongside the 95% aggregate one.
concentration_ceiling.enforcement: RotationEngine._execute_buy clamps each buy budget by a per-position headroom of 0.50 * equity minus the position's current value, and by an aggregate headroom of 0.95 * equity minus total position value. Both are computed from marks taken at the FILL session's OPEN, never its close.
concentration_ceiling.interaction_with_equal_weighting: See G2-CONFLICT-9 in governance/generation_2/STAGE_3_G2_ROTATION_PROTOCOL.md. At k=1 the ceiling binds before the gross-exposure cap does, so a k=1 variant is structurally half in cash. That consequence is disclosed before any variant is run and is not a reason to relax the ceiling.

open_marking_note: Generation 1's BacktestEngine._execute_buy marks already-held positions with _mark(symbol, session), which returns that session's CLOSE. With at most one open position that call is either empty or self-referential and reads nothing, so it was harmless. With k > 1 it would value the rest of the book at the close of the very session the buy fills at the open — same-session close information used at the open. Generation 2 therefore marks at the open. Recorded as G2-CONFLICT-14.
not_authorized_by_this_file: any change to a friction, fee, rounding direction, or benchmark assumption
any order, paper or live, at any broker
any reading of a credential, by name or by value
